'''All-Terrain Attack Vehicle''', or '''AT-AV''' for short, was the nickname of a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[pittin]] that was a pet belonging to [[Tia Organa]], one of [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa's]] adoptive aunts on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].

As a child, Leia had named the creature herself. AT-AV had a pale candy-pink [[Color/Legends|color]] and was small enough to fit in Leia's cupped hands. She also liked to roll on her back and bat at Leia's braids and [[Starblossom/Legends|starblossom]] petals. AT-AV died in the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction of Alderaan]].
